story: Write Russian in 100–150 words. All title, text, vocabulary headwords and story forms must use Cyrillic. Never give Latin transliteration or added stress marks. English glossary meanings remain English. Favor short everyday clauses and common present-tense patterns; use cases, number, gender, and verb agreement correctly. Avoid advanced participial constructions. Match selected dictionary forms to actual inflected forms in the glossary.
suggestions: Suggest 5–10 useful Russian beginner vocabulary items for the optional topic. Use Cyrillic only, with no Latin transliteration and no added stress marks.
